fields.label: Revenue
fields.description: total revenue or net sales of the current period

fields.label: Operating income
fields.description: operating income or operating profit (EBIT if that is the operating figure printed) of the current period

fields.label: Net income
fields.description: net income, net profit or net earnings of the current period (the one attributable to shareholders if both are printed)

fields.label: EPS
fields.description: earnings per share of the current period (diluted if both are printed)

fields.label: Interest expense
fields.description: interest expense of the current period

fields.label: Operating cash flow
fields.description: net cash from operating activities of the current period

fields.label: Capex
fields.description: capital expenditures, the purchases of property, plant and equipment, of the current period

fields.label: Previous-year revenue
fields.description: total revenue or net sales of the previous year

fields.label: Previous-year net income
fields.description: net income of the previous year

fields.label: Previous-year EPS
fields.description: earnings per share of the previous year

fields.label: Revenue growth
fields.description: percent change of revenue, only if the text states it

fields.label: Net income growth
fields.description: percent change of net income, only if the text states it

fields.label: EPS growth
fields.description: percent change of earnings per share, only if the text states it

fields.label: Total debt
fields.description: total borrowings as printed on the balance sheet
